entries.summaryZh: 2009年10月3日，约300名塔利班武装分子袭击阿富汗努里斯坦省卡姆代什附近的美军基廷前哨基地。这场战斗是2008年瓦纳特之战以来美军伤亡最重的一次，美军8人阵亡、27人受伤，前哨几乎被摧毁。此后联军撤出该基地，这与美军收缩偏远据点、集中兵力的整体部署调整一致。
entries.summaryEn: On 3 October 2009 about 300 Taliban fighters assaulted the American Combat Outpost Keating near Kamdesh in Nuristan Province, Afghanistan. Eight Americans were killed and 27 wounded, the bloodiest day for US forces since Wanat in 2008, and the outpost was nearly destroyed; coalition forces withdrew from the base shortly afterwards.
entries.significanceZh: 卡姆代什战役是阿富汗战争中美军前哨防御最惨烈的战例之一，加速了联军撤离偏远据点的调整。
entries.significanceEn: Kamdesh was among the bloodiest defensive actions of the Afghanistan war and accelerated the coalition's withdrawal from remote outposts.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记2009年10月3日，维基数据P585同日、精度到日，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

Chinese Wikipedia has no article on the battle, so only the English article and the Wikidata entity are cited. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 313年4月30日，四帝共治内战期间，李锡尼与马克西米努斯两军在色雷斯特兹拉卢姆（今土耳其乔尔卢）的宁静原野决战。李锡尼获胜，马克西米努斯败逃后不久病死，李锡尼由此控制帝国东部，与西部的君士坦丁形成两强并立的格局。此役是四帝共治体系瓦解过程中的关键一战。
entries.summaryEn: On 30 April 313, during the civil wars of the Tetrarchy, the armies of Licinius and Maximinus fought at Tzirallum, modern Corlu in Thrace. Licinius won; Maximinus fled and died soon afterwards, leaving Licinius master of the eastern empire and one of only two Augusti alongside Constantine in the west.
entries.significanceZh: 特兹拉卢姆之战使李锡尼掌控帝国东部，四帝共治体系至此彻底瓦解为两强对峙。
entries.significanceEn: Tzirallum gave Licinius the eastern empire and completed the collapse of the Tetrarchy into a contest between two Augusti.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记313年4月30日，维基数据P585同日、精度到日，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

entries.titleZh: 斯文达克斯战役（Battle of Svindax）
entries.summaryZh: 1022年春，拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世率军在斯文达克斯击败格鲁吉亚国王乔治一世的军队。双方因陶-克拉耶蒂地区的争夺再起战端，此役后乔治一世被迫求和，承认拜占庭对争议地区的控制，并送幼子巴格拉特为质。拜占庭在高加索的势力由此达到顶峰。
entries.summaryEn: In the spring of 1022 the Byzantine emperor Basil II defeated the Georgian army of King George I at Svindax. The two had gone to war over the Tao-Klarjeti lands; after the defeat George sued for peace, accepted Byzantine control of the disputed territories and sent his young son Bagrat as a hostage.
entries.significanceZh: 斯文达克斯战役迫使格鲁吉亚求和，使拜占庭在高加索的势力达到顶峰。
entries.significanceEn: Svindax forced Georgia to make peace and brought Byzantine power in the Caucasus to its height.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1022年春，维基数据P585为1022年、精度到年，本条只保留年份精度；中文标签本身带有拉丁文注释，按来源标签原样保留。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

Chinese Wikipedia has no article, so only the English article and the Wikidata entity are cited. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 1063年5月8日，阿拉贡国王拉米罗一世在韦斯卡附近的格劳斯与萨拉戈萨泰法交战，拉米罗本人在战斗期间或战后身亡，阿拉贡的扩张受挫。此役的断代存在争议，有学者改定为1069年甚至1070年。传说熙德曾为萨拉戈萨一方参战，但这一说法缺乏同时代证据。
entries.summaryEn: On 8 May 1063 King Ramiro I of Aragon fought the Taifa of Zaragoza at Graus near Huesca and died in or as a result of the battle, checking Aragonese expansion. The dating is disputed, with one historian re-dating the battle to 1069 and a later chronicle to 1070; the tradition that El Cid fought there rests on late evidence.
entries.significanceZh: 格劳斯战役使阿拉贡国王拉米罗一世阵亡，暂时遏止了阿拉贡向埃布罗河谷的扩张。
entries.significanceEn: Graus killed King Ramiro I and temporarily halted Aragonese expansion towards the Ebro valley.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基以传统所记1063年5月8日为主，同时列出改定为1069年与1070年的说法，维基数据P585为1063年5月8日、精度到日；本条采用1063年并只保留年份精度，争议见正文。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。
entries.notesEn: The English article treats 8 May 1063 as the traditional date while recording re-datings to 1069 and 1070; the Wikidata P585 statement gives 8 May 1063 at day precision. The entry uses 1063 at year precision and states the dispute. Chinese Wikipedia has no article, so the citations are the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 1080年10月14日，德意志国王亨利四世与对立国王莱茵费尔登的鲁道夫在埃尔斯特河畔的霍恩默尔森进行第三次也是最后一次交战。鲁道夫一方获胜，但他本人在战斗中受致命伤，次日死去。反亨利阵营失去核心人物，叙任权斗争中的内战格局随之改变。
entries.summaryEn: On 14 October 1080 Henry IV and the anti-king Rudolf of Rheinfelden fought their third and last battle at Hohenmolsen on the White Elster. Rudolf's side won, but he was mortally wounded and died the next day, leaving the opposition to Henry without its figurehead.
entries.significanceZh: 埃尔斯特河战役虽以鲁道夫获胜告终，但他本人战死，反亨利阵营从此失去有力的对立国王。
entries.significanceEn: Rudolf won on the Elster but died of his wounds, depriving the opposition to Henry IV of its anti-king.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1080年10月14日，维基数据P585同日、精度到日，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

entries.summaryZh: 约1235年，曼丁卡王子松迪亚塔·凯塔在基里纳击败索索国王苏曼古鲁·坎特，后者战败后消失。此役奠定了凯塔家族新建的马里帝国在西非的霸主地位，马里随后控制跨撒哈拉黄金与食盐贸易。基里纳之战也是西非口述史诗《松迪亚塔》的核心情节。
entries.summaryEn: Around 1235 the Mandinka prince Sundiata Keita defeated the Sosso king Sumanguru Kante at Kirina. The victory established Sundiata's new Mali Empire as the leading power in West Africa, which went on to control the trans-Saharan gold and salt trade, and the battle is the central episode of the oral epic of Sundiata.
entries.significanceZh: 基里纳战役确立了马里帝国在西非的霸权，是西非中世纪政治格局的转折点。
entries.significanceEn: Kirina established the Mali Empire's dominance in West Africa and marked a turning point in the region's medieval political order.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记约1235年，维基数据P585为1235年、精度到年，本条采用1235年并保留年份精度，正文以约字表示其约数性质。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

Chinese Wikipedia has no article, so the citations are the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 1599年10月18日，瓦拉几亚大公米哈伊尔勇者在锡比乌附近的谢林伯尔击败特兰西瓦尼亚-匈牙利军队，对手安德烈·巴托里在败退途中被杀。米哈伊尔由此短暂地把瓦拉几亚、特兰西瓦尼亚与摩尔达维亚置于自己统治之下，成为罗马尼亚历史上首次三公国联合的象征。
entries.summaryEn: On 18 October 1599 Michael the Brave of Wallachia defeated the Transylvanian-Hungarian army of Andrew Bathory near Selimbar by Sibiu; Bathory was killed as he fled. Michael briefly ruled Wallachia, Transylvania and Moldavia together, the episode later celebrated as the first union of the three Romanian principalities.
entries.significanceZh: 谢林伯尔战役使米哈伊尔勇者短暂统一三公国，成为罗马尼亚历史叙事中首次联合的象征。
entries.significanceEn: Selimbar let Michael the Brave unite the three principalities briefly and became the symbol of their first union in Romanian historiography.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1599年10月18日，维基数据P585为1599年10月28日、精度到日，两者相差十天，属旧历与新历差异；本条采用英文条目的日期并只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

Chinese Wikipedia has no article, so only the English article and the Wikidata entity are cited. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 1685年7月6日，英格兰萨默塞特郡塞奇高沼爆发蒙茅斯起义的最后决战，詹姆斯二世的军队击败蒙茅斯公爵的叛军并俘获约五百人。蒙茅斯本人逃离战场后被捕，九天后在伦敦被处死，其支持者随后在血腥巡回法庭中受到大规模审判与严惩，许多人被处死或流放。
entries.summaryEn: On 6 July 1685 the forces of James II defeated the rebel army of the Duke of Monmouth at Sedgemoor in Somerset, the final battle of the Monmouth Rebellion, taking about 500 prisoners. Monmouth escaped but was captured, taken to London and executed nine days later, and his supporters were punished in the Bloody Assizes.
entries.significanceZh: 塞奇高沼之战终结了蒙茅斯起义，巩固了詹姆斯二世的王位，其后的血腥审判成为英国司法史上的著名事件。
entries.significanceEn: Sedgemoor ended the Monmouth Rebellion, secured James II on the throne and was followed by the Bloody Assizes that became notorious in English legal history.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1685年7月6日，维基数据P585同日、精度到日，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

entries.summaryZh: 1914年11月6日至8日，英军在两河流域战役中登陆法奥，攻击奥斯曼据守的法奥堡。奥斯曼守军在猛烈炮击后撤离，登陆几乎没有遇到抵抗。这是第一次世界大战美索不达米亚战役的首次军事行动，目的是保护英国在波斯湾的石油供应，随后英军沿河向巴士拉推进。
entries.summaryEn: From 6 to 8 November 1914 British forces landed at Fao and attacked the Ottoman fortress there, the first operation of the Mesopotamian campaign of the First World War. The defenders fled after heavy shelling and the landing met little resistance; it was mounted to protect British oil supplies in the Persian Gulf.
entries.significanceZh: 法奥登陆揭开了美索不达米亚战役，是英国为保卫波斯湾石油利益而发动的地面作战起点。
entries.significanceEn: Fao opened the Mesopotamian campaign and was the starting point of British ground operations to protect Persian Gulf oil.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1914年11月6日至8日，维基数据P585为1914年11月6日、精度到日，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

Chinese Wikipedia has no article, so only the English article and the Wikidata entity are cited. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 1915年8月5日至8日，高加索战线的俄军在卡拉基利塞反击追击中的奥斯曼军队。俄军将领尤登尼奇集中约两万援军从西侧包抄，土军被迫南撤，损失火炮、大量物资与约一万人的伤亡。此役紧接7月的马拉兹吉尔特之战，遏止了土军在阿勒山一带的推进。
entries.summaryEn: From 5 to 8 August 1915, on the Caucasus front, the Russian general Yudenich counter-attacked the advancing Ottoman army at Kara Killisse with some 20,000 reinforcements, mostly Cossacks. The Turks retreated south, losing guns, large quantities of supplies and about 10,000 killed and wounded, which checked their advance after the July battle of Manzikert.
entries.significanceZh: 卡拉基利塞战役遏止了奥斯曼军队在高加索战线的推进，是1915年该战线态势逆转的关键交战。
entries.significanceEn: Kara Killisse checked the Ottoman advance on the Caucasus front and marked the turn of the campaign in 1915.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1915年8月5日至8日，并把它归入7月9日至8月3日的阿拉什凯尔特防御行动，维基数据P585为1915年、精度到年；本条只保留年份精度并采用英文条目的日期范围。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。
entries.notesEn: The English article dates the fighting to 5-8 August 1915, treating it as part of the Alashkert defensive operation of 9 July to 3 August, while the Wikidata P585 statement records 1915 at year precision; the entry keeps year precision and follows the article's range. Chinese Wikipedia has no article, so the citations are the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.
